blocks.orig: Chem Chem Lodge offers a cosy retreat with just eight tented suites, including one family suite, giving you plenty of space without the crowds. The lodge can accommodate up to 16 adults and 2 children, so it’s perfect for those seeking a more intimate experience. Each suite comes with both indoor and outdoor showers, and you’ll find the essentials like fans, mosquito nets, and even a “gym-in-a-basket” for some sneaky workouts. If you’re more of a relaxer, no worries – there’s a butler service on hand, ready to cater to your every need.
blocks.html: Chem Chem Lodge is a cosy hideaway with only eight tented suites, one of them a family suite, so you have lots of room and no crowds. With space for up to 16 adults and 2 children, it’s ideal if you would like a more intimate stay. Every suite has an indoor as well as an outdoor shower, and the basics are covered with fans, mosquito nets and even a “gym-in-a-basket” for a sneaky workout. Prefer to relax? That’s fine too – a butler service is available to take care of whatever you need.

blocks.orig: Families are well taken care of too! There is a family suite features two bedrooms and bathrooms, comfortably fitting up to 2 children and 2 adults, which means you get some extra room to stretch out while keeping your little ones close. WiFi is available in the suites, but the connection speed (which fluctuates) might remind you to slow down and enjoy the views – maybe that’s the lodge’s secret charm!
